## Exercise

Create an interactive map of the MCP home ranges of the four fisher. Make sure they are labled with their names (*Hint: make use of the argument `zcol` in `mapview()`). 


## Solution 

First load the data and create a track:

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show solution"
#| eval: FALSE

library(amt)
library(tidyverse)

data("amt_fisher")
```


Calcualte home ranges

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show solution"
#| eval: FALSE

dat1 <- amt_fisher |> nest(data = -name) |>
  mutate(hr = map(data, ~ hr_mcp(., trast = trast, level = c(0.95))))

```

Create a map. 


```{r}
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show solution"
#| eval: FALSE

library(mapview)
dat1 |> hr_to_sf(hr, name) |> 
  mapview(zcol = "name")
```
